description: Plan one HelloFresh delivery week for a planner profile (hf_list_profiles — e.g. a 4-person family week) in one read: the box size the week needs versus what it has, suggested picks with alternates, the box price (HelloFresh’s own checkout total for that size plus the picks’ premium upcharge, or a labelled local estimate when that cannot be read), a one-line summary for the user to approve, and the exact follow-up write calls (hf_unskip_week, hf_set_week_size, hf_select_meals) in order. The subscription’s first box cannot be resized, so for it no size change is proposed (notes say so). Read-only: it changes nothing.

avoid_indexes.description: Menu indexes never to suggest (e.g. a recipe someone dislikes).

avoid_recent_weeks.description: Skip recipes picked in this many weeks before the week (default: the profile’s avoidRepeatWeeks, usually 4; 0 allows repeats). Read best effort, like hf_recent_picks.

box_number.description: This box’s number, counting every box ever delivered — overrides the number derived from next_box_number. Only used by the local estimate (when HelloFresh’s price cannot be read).

max_premium_per_serving_cents.description: Highest premium upcharge per serving, in US cents (default: the profile’s premiumCapCents; 0 = no premiums).

next_box_number.description: Which box this account’s NEXT running delivery will be, counting every box ever delivered (1 = the first box). The voucher’s discount depends on it. Default: 1 when HelloFresh says the first box is not delivered yet; otherwise an assumed 2 (HelloFresh does not say how many boxes were delivered).

people.description: Servings for this week only, overriding the profile’s people (2, 3, 4 or 6).

profile.description: The planner profile to plan for, by name (hf_list_profiles lists them; the built-ins are "couple", "family"). A profile sets the servings and meal count, the allowed recipe categories, and what to favour (kid friendly, quick, adventurous) and the premium cap. Decide which profile applies to the week before calling.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_weekly_plan
